'''Cell Block D''' was a detention area aboard the [[Desolation Alley]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] maximum security federal [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. The [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] course known as [[The Gauntlet (Podrace course)/Legends|The Gauntlet]] ran through the cell block.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
